block.thaumicexploration.soul_brazier.no: The brazier needs vis and essentia before it will burn.
You have no permanent warp to give it.
This brazier answers only to the one who placed it.
block.thaumicexploration.soul_brazier.re: Your Soul Brazier has gone out; %s warp returns to you.
block.thaumicexploration.soul_brazier.st: The brazier takes %s warp from you.
death.attack.thaumicexploration.soul_cru: %s had their soul drawn into a crucible
item.thaumicexploration.linked_chest_sea: The seal takes the chest's binding
jei.thaumicexploration.linked_chest_seal: Use a second chest binding seal of the same colour on a bound chest: it comes back as a linked seal of that chest's network. Use the linked seal on another chest to join it to the network.
jei.thaumicexploration.replicator: Give the Replicator a plain building block from the thaumicexploration:replicable tag as a template, then pulse it with redstone: it draws the block's aspects as essentia from jars in range, one point at a time, and forms a copy.
jei.thaumicexploration.soul_brazier: Holds its owner's permanent warp while it burns on Ignis vis and Mortuus essentia. Keeps its chunk loaded and spreads taint while lit.
jei.thaumicexploration.soul_crucible: The Crucible of Souls latches on to the nearest creature and slowly drains it. When the creature dies its aspects become essentia in the crucible; some break down into their components and some are lost as flux. Pipe the essentia out with tubes.
jei.thaumicexploration.think_tank: Set the Think Tank on a bookshelf and give it books: it slowly reads them into Illuminating Curiosities. Hoppers can fill and empty it.
jei.thaumicexploration.trash_jar: Voids any essentia, items or fluids piped into it.
research.thaumicexploration.binding.stag: A blade that pins what it strikes to the spot would be a fine thing to have.

Infuse a book with Binding and apply it to a sword at an anvil. Creatures struck by the first level are badly slowed for a moment. The second level also binds them: a struck enderman cannot teleport away, and a struck creeper's fuse goes out for a few seconds. Binding will not sit on a blade with Fire Aspect.
research.thaumicexploration.binding_seal: A seal pressed with the right aspects might tie two containers together, however far apart they stand.

Craft a blank seal from four tallow round any dye. In the crucible, Alienis, Permutatio, Vinculum and Motus with Vacuos make it a chest binding seal; with Vitreus instead, a jar binding seal.

Use a chest seal on a chest to bind it. Use a second seal of the same colour on that bound chest to get a linked seal, and put the linked seal on another chest: both now open the same 27 slots, in any dimension. Breaking a bound chest gives back the chest and a linked seal; the items stay bound.

Use a jar seal on an empty, unlabelled warded jar. Every jar sealed with the same colour shares its essentia; rename the seal in an anvil to make a separate network of that colour.
research.thaumicexploration.brain_cure.s: A zombie villager can be cured with weakness and a golden apple. Perhaps a zombie's brain can too.
Infuse a zombie brain with a fermented spider eye (the weakness), a golden apple and a bucket of water. The result is a purified brain: a working mind, no longer hungry for flesh.
research.thaumicexploration.cap_mechanis: Gadgetry and magic together might pull vis out of a relay network faster than any wand can on its own.

While a wand with Mechanist's caps is in your hand and a vis relay reaches you, the caps pull one vis a second of a primal aspect the wand is short of out of the relay network. They channel vis a little better than gold, though not as well as thaumium. Build inert caps from redstone, a piston and a repeater, then wake them by infusion with salis mundus.
research.thaumicexploration.cap_sojourne: Refilling a wand at a pedestal is a chore. A cap that drinks from the world around it as you walk would spare you the trip.

While a wand with Sojourner's caps is in your hand, it draws one vis a second from the aura of the chunk you stand in, picking one primal aspect that is not yet full. The caps channel vis a little better than gold, though not as well as thaumium. Shape inert caps from lapis and a diamond, then wake them by infusion with salis mundus.
The Boots of the Traveller are fast, but there is room for more speed. Aqua and Gelum might give it.
These boots are much faster than the traveller's, and the longer you sprint the faster you go. Water freezes under your feet as you cross it, melting back behind you, and falls hurt you less.
research.thaumicexploration.disarming.st: Infuse a book with Disarming and apply it to a sword at an anvil. Struck creatures may drop the weapon they are holding: one blow in eight at the first level, one in six at the second and one in four at the third. Players are never disarmed, and the enchantment will not sit with Looting.
research.thaumicexploration.discount_rin: Primal crystals pressed into a band might lend the wearer a feel for vis.

Six rings, one for each primal, each made from four crystals of its aspect. Worn in a ring slot, a primal ring makes all your wand and focus casting cost 3% less vis. The rings stack with each other and with Thaumaturge's own gear.
research.thaumicexploration.dreamcatcher: Dreamcatchers are said to keep nightmares from reaching the mind. Taint is no dream, but perhaps a dreamcatcher could be taught to catch it all the same.

Wear the Wispy Dreamcatcher as a charm, or simply carry it in your hotbar, and three times in four it turns aside harm from taint, taintacles, swarms and tainted creatures. It will not stop everything, but tainted lands become far less dangerous.
research.thaumicexploration.everburn_urn: If an urn can be made to brim with water forever, perhaps another can be made to brim with fire.

Unlike water, lava takes energy to make, so the Everburn Urn draws Ignis: from a vis relay if one reaches it, otherwise from the aura of its chunk. Each draw of one vis becomes 250 mB of lava, up to 4000 mB. Fill buckets from it, or pump the lava out of its top into a tank.
research.thaumicexploration.flesh_cure.s: Rotten flesh is foul, but it is still flesh. The right aspects might draw the rot out of it.

Steeped in a crucible holding Bestia and Fabrico, rotten flesh loses nearly every trace of disease and decay and comes out as two pieces of leather. Not a great discovery, perhaps, but surely it leads to better things.
research.thaumicexploration.floating_can: Tallow candles are missing something. A touch of Aer should make them fit for any wizarding school.

Three candles of a colour and an aer crystal make three floating candles. They need nothing beneath them, hang in the air where you place them, give bright light and, like ordinary candles, help steady an infusion.
research.thaumicexploration.meteor_boots: The Boots of the Traveller are useful, but you want more from them. Raw Ignis and Potentia might do it.

Jump while crouching and these boots fling you the way you are looking. Crouch in midair and you dive for the ground, bursting on impact and hurting whatever stands nearby; the longer the dive, the bigger the burst. You take no fall damage while wearing them, and you walk a little faster and step up whole blocks.
research.thaumicexploration.night_vision: Darkness is only a lack of light. A helmet could make up the difference.
Infuse a book with Night Vision and apply it to a helmet at an anvil. Its wearer sees in the dark as if under a potion of night vision. It will not sit with Respiration or Aqua Affinity.
research.thaumicexploration.replicator.s: Every block is made of aspects. Given the aspects, and the pattern, it should be possible to make another.

Use a plain building block on the replicator to set the template: stone, dirt, sand, logs and planks, bricks, glass and the like. A redstone pulse (or using it while sneaking, empty-handed) starts a copy. The replicator draws the block's aspects one point at a time from jars and other essentia stores within twelve blocks, then forms the copy. Use it empty-handed to take the copies; a hopper can take them too. With nothing made, using it cancels the copy, then clears the template.
research.thaumicexploration.rod_amber.st: Amber is a poor conduit for vis, yet it seems to hold a fleeting memory of the vis that once passed through it.

An amber core holds only 10 vis of each kind, but it remembers what it has lost: while it is not full, every primal aspect slowly comes back on its own, all six at once rather than one in particular. Bind an amber block with salis mundus by infusion to make one.
research.thaumicexploration.rod_amber_st: Two amber cores joined by a primal charm might remember more.
An amber staff core stores 25 vis of each kind and, like the wand core, slowly replenishes every aspect that is not full.
research.thaumicexploration.rod_bread.st: Yesterday you bought one baguette too many. It would be a shame to let good bread go to waste.
Infuse a loaf with salis mundus and it will hold 39 vis of each kind, like any modest core. It does talk now and then. Bon appetit!
research.thaumicexploration.rod_necroman: A bone staff core steeped in the remnants of the undead might feed on death itself.

The Necromancer's staff core holds 200 vis of each kind. Every monster you slay with it in hand feeds it vis drawn from the creature's life, and every monster you strike with it begins to wither. The dark magic has a price: only three quarters of the vis it gets any other way ever reaches it.
research.thaumicexploration.rod_transmut: A core built around a primal charm and a vis crystal of every primal might let one kind of vis become another.

The transmutative core holds 75 vis of each kind. Whenever an aspect falls to nine tenths of its capacity or lower, vis above that mark in the other aspects is converted to refill it. The conversion is wasteful: only a quarter of the vis survives.
The same trick should work at the scale of a staff.
A transmutative staff core stores 175 vis of each kind and transmutes vis like the wand core.
research.thaumicexploration.soul_brazier: Warp is a malicious thing. Within a mind it is bad enough; released into the world it is worse. But perhaps it could be held somewhere other than yourself, for a while.

Place a Soul Brazier, feed it Ignis vis from a relay (or the aura) and Mortuus essentia through a tube from below, then light it with an empty hand: it takes all of your permanent warp and holds it while it burns. A lit brazier keeps its chunk loaded, and the land around it slowly sickens with taint. When it runs out of vis or essentia, or is broken, your warp comes back to you, even if you are away at the time.
research.thaumicexploration.soul_crucibl: A creature is aspects bound by a soul. Unbind it slowly enough and the aspects might be caught.

The Crucible of Souls fastens on the nearest creature within five blocks and drains it, a point of health every half second. When it dies its aspects fall into the crucible: about a third survive whole, a third break into one of their components, and the rest become flux that taints the aura. It only works open to the sky above it. Draw the essentia off with tubes.
research.thaumicexploration.stabilizer_b: The thaumostatic harness holds you aloft. Turned inward, the same field might hold you in place.
Worn as a belt, the Thaumostatic Stabilizer cancels knockback entirely: when you are hit you stay where you are. Useful when flying with the harness, and for travel at night.
research.thaumicexploration.taint_basics: Sometimes thaumaturgy goes horribly wrong. Flux left to stagnate seeps into the land, and the land turns: soil grows thick and pulpy, trees are crusted over with violet fibres, and every creature that lives there is warped into something hostile to ordinary life.
Tainted land spreads on its own, sending its fibres out into whatever borders it. You have begun to think about how its own nature might be turned against it, or turned to your use.
research.thaumicexploration.talisman_foo: Food spoils, and eating takes time. A charm could eat for you and keep the goodness until it is needed.

Keep the Talisman of Nourishment anywhere in your inventory. Every second it eats one harmless food from your hotbar (anything without side effects) and stores its nourishment, up to 1000 points. Whenever you are hungry it feeds you from that store: hunger first, then saturation.
research.thaumicexploration.tentacle_rin: The great taintacles of the tainted lands answer to nothing. A small one might be made to answer to you.

Wear this ring and, whenever you are hurt while standing on solid ground, a small taintacle bursts up beside you and lashes at hostile creatures nearby, starting with whatever struck you. It never turns on players and withers away after ten seconds.
research.thaumicexploration.think_tank.s: A purified brain still wants to think. Given books, it might think for you.

Put the Think Tank on a bookshelf with the space around it clear (a 3x3x3 room, the shelf aside). Use books on it, or feed them in with a hopper. Every ten seconds it reads one: a plain book gives an Illuminating Curiosity one time in ten, an enchanted book one or two of them two times in three. Use it with an empty hand to take what it has made; a hopper underneath takes it too.
research.thaumicexploration.trash_jar.st: A void jar still fills up in the end. One that opens onto nothing at all would never need emptying.

The Jar of Oblivion can never be filled. Set it under a tube and it draws essentia with weak suction, so it only takes what nothing else wants, and destroys it.

It destroys more than essentia: hoppers, pipes and anything else that pushes items or fluids into it lose them for good. Mind what you connect to it.
